message: I’ve always been a bit of a preparedness enthusiast, and I have to say, it feels pretty good to know I’m ready for the occasional blackout. This resource from the Red Cross is a treasure trove for anyone looking to get ahead of the game. It’s all about simple steps to make sure you and your family stay comfortable and safe when the lights go out. Have you ever had to deal with a power outage? What did you do to keep things running smoothly?
